Joint Base Charleston may soon carry a new name: Joint Base Lindsey Graham.

The Secretary of the Air Force has ordered staff to begin the process of renaming the installation, citing his decades of service to both the Air Force and Congress.

Graham spent years fighting for this base. He helped secure hundreds of millions in federal funding, played a key role in bringing Boeing to South Carolina, and just this May helped direct $212 million toward Coast Guard readiness there.
